text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Like this... I won't be able to entertain 
anyone, will I...?"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...What was I lacking? Effort... 
determination... or perhaps—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I just don't have... the talent to 
be an entertainer...
choice_data_list: Nobody wants to see you give up!
No one wants to see you give up!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I just don't have... the talent to 
be an entertainer...
choice_data_list: Nobody wants to see you give up!
No one wants to see you give up!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
choice_data_list: Look how much you're agonizing over this.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. My desire to entertain everyone 
won't lose to anyone.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
If it's for that, I don't care how much I 
have to worry or suffer...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Even if it's the long way around, I want 
to take more time to think it through."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
So that I can run in races as an 
entertainer once more...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"The Fuji Kiseki... that everyone wants to 
see... I see... You're right."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That there are fans out there looking 
forward to my "Miracle"...!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer! I won't lose ever 
again!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'll show you a run that you can enjoy 
from the bottom of your heart!
